translations.web: Therefore if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.
translations.bsb: Therefore, if what I eat causes my brother to stumble, I will never eat meat again, so that I will not cause him to stumble.
translations.kjv: Wherefore, if meat make ➔ my brother to offend, I will eat no flesh while the world standeth, lest I make ➔ my brother to offend.
translations.asv: Wherefore, if meat causeth my brother to stumble, I will eat no flesh for evermore, that I cause not my brother to stumble.
